definitions.gloss: lightness; light weight; lack of heaviness
definitions.explanation: The physical quality of being light in weight, or the degree to which something is not heavy.
A quality of being easygoing, casual, or lacking seriousness. Can be positive (approachability) or negative (superficiality).

examples.english: Thanks to her light, casual way of speaking, even people meeting her for the first time can relax and open up quickly.

notes:
Formed from the i-adjective ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ by replacing い with さ, following the standard pattern for turning i-adjectives into nouns expressing degree or quality.

Sense 1 (physical lightness) is straightforward and always positive. Sense 2 (lightness of manner) is ambiguous — it can be a compliment describing approachability and ease, or a criticism implying lack of seriousness or depth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽|かる}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧: lightness is the appeal
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軽|かる}さ: surprising lightness
- ⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軽|かる}さ: frivolity of one's words
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軽|かる}さ: physical agility; nimbleness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧: heaviness; weight — the antonym, formed the same way from ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧
- ⟦{軽量|けいりょう}→軽量：19124_keiryou⟧: lightweight — a more technical, compound word used for products and materials
- {気軽|きがる}さ: casualness; ease — specifically about attitude or atmosphere, always positive
